IGUI_GMAW_Screwdriver: Tool: working screwdriver in player inventory.
IGUI_GMAW_Wrench: Tool: working wrench or pipe wrench in player inventory.
IGUI_GMAW_BothTools: Tools: working screwdriver AND wrench/pipe wrench in player inventory.
IGUI_GMAW_NoTools: No installation tool required by GoM for this slot.
IGUI_GMAW_Parts: Attachments by slot - click to queue / unqueue
IGUI_GMAW_Hint: Choose a slot arrow, then a part. Review the cart before applying.
IGUI_GMAW_Unsupported: Unsupported definition or API. No work applied.
IGUI_GMAW_Dependency: Required compatible mount is missing or would be invalid.
IGUI_GMAW_Tools: Working tools must be in your inventory; attachment rules still apply.
IGUI_GMAW_Stale: Items changed. Refresh before starting again.
IGUI_GMAW_Special: Use the original menu for loaded/stateful underbarrel removal.
IGUI_GMAW_ChooseSlot: Select a slot arrow to browse parts.
IGUI_GMAW_ActionsQueued: Transferring parts, then assembling with normal actions. Esc cancels remaining work.
IGUI_GMAW_Busy: Finish or cancel your current action first.
IGUI_GMAW_Stopped: Work stopped. Completed transfers and upgrades remain; review the refreshed list.
